Equipped with a clickable propel/repel mechanism, the offers quick, one-handed operation while maintaining durability for extended use. The stylish cut-out clip not only enhances the modern aesthetic but also provides secure attachment to pockets, planners, and notebooks.

This leather passport holder is perfect for frequent travelers and professionals who value organized storage with a polished appearance. The high-quality leather finish enhances durability while delivering a premium tactile experience that complements the elegance.

Whether you are looking for a luxury for employees, clients, or leadership teams, this branded set makes a lasting impression. Its universal appeal suits occasions such as corporate events, onboarding kits, promotions, anniversaries, festive gifting, and business milestones.
